summary: v51aa — Vendor bulk CSV template + structured 409 + admin full-profile edit. ALL PASS. Backend 4/4 pytest (bulk template CSV has email + all 45 Section A–E fields, Content-Disposition filename=pmc_vendor_bulk_template.csv; bulk invite with full columns persists coerced profile fields: employees_count int=25, turnover_year1 float=500000.0, operating_regions=['KZ','UZ'], decl_integrity=True; invite on already-active email returns 409 with detail OBJECT {code:'vendor_already_active', vendor_ref, email, message}; GET /admin/{ref}/full returns 200 w/ profile dict and 404 on missing; PATCH /admin/{ref}/full merges profile — new keys applied, untouched signatory_name='Keep Me' preserved, profile_updated_at + profile_updated_by set). Frontend verified end-to-end: Admin → Vendors loads 44 vendors, Bulk invite modal shows both 'Download full Sections A–E template' (data-testid=bulk-invite-rich-template, href=/api/v1/vendors/invite-bulk/template) AND legacy 'Minimal 4-column sample' button. Every vendor row has data-testid=vendor-edit-<ref> Edit full profile link; clicking navigates to /admin/vendors/{ref}/edit which renders admin-vendor-edit with disabled email field (admin-vendor-edit-email), save-section-a..e buttons and Save & close. Single invite submit with manualvendor@pmcmanagers.com shows toast 'Manual Preview Vendor Ltd already exists · PMC-VEN-MANUAL-01 — This email is already an active vendor. Open their profile to edit it instead.' with 'Edit full profile' action button — no bare 'HTTP 409' alert anywhere. Regression unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /admin/{ref}/full correctly merges profile sub-doc (dict.update) rather than replacing — partial section saves safe.
Pydantic VendorProfilePatchIn uses ConfigDict(extra='allow') and filters denylisted keys (_id, password_hash, magic_token, tenant_id, vendor_ref, email) before $set. Safe.
Bulk template response correctly sets text/csv and attachment Content-Disposition; sorted(_SECTION_FIELDS) ordering is deterministic — good for CSV diffing.
409 detail is a dict now; any older client code that did `JSON.parse(err.detail)` or string-matched would break. Spot-checked: admin UI handles via error.response.data.detail object as expected.
Minor — invite-bulk coercion silently drops malformed int/float values (returns None). Consider surfacing per-cell parse warnings in the per-row result for admin feedback. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — bulk-invite-rich-template link, legacy sample button, 20+ vendor-edit-<ref> links, AdminVendorEdit route loads, disabled email, save-section A–E buttons, save-close, structured 409 toast with Edit full profile action
